learnings.title: Federal Reserve Board press releases RSS: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by The Bank of Nova Scotia
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve press release orders20261029a (29 Oct 2026, for release 4:30 p.m. EDT, read 2026-10-31, HTTP 200) states the Board approved the application by The Bank of Nova Scotia (Toronto, Canada) to become a bank holding company by acquiring Maple Financial Holdings, Inc. (Dallas, Texas), thereby indirectly acquiring MapleMark Bank (Tulsa, Oklahoma). This is a routine bank-holding-company order, not a monetary policy action.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: Low relevance for the finance plan; record as a regulatory order only and do not treat it as a market or rate signal. No operational change.
learnings.next_measurement: Confirm the next Finance report does not cite this order as a policy signal; record yes/no before 2026-11-07.

learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Webhook IP ranges added to the Meta API
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog item 2026-10-29-webhook-ip-ranges-added-to-the-meta-api (29 Oct 2026, read 2026-10-31, HTTP 200) states GitHub added IP ranges for github.com webhook deliveries, now listed in the Meta API hooks field: 9.234.98.160/28, 9.234.98.176/28 and 9.234.106.48/28. Static webhook allowlists must add these CIDRs to avoid rejecting deliveries; allowlists kept current from the Meta API need no change. Applies to all plans including GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: system plan should check whether any webhook receiver uses a static IP allowlist; if so add the three CIDRs or switch to reading the Meta API. No change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Check whether any system webhook receiver filters by static GitHub IP list; record found/not-found before 2026-11-07.

learnings.title: Shopify developer changelog feed: Shop SDK lead capture now supports Rich Authorization Requests
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog page shop-sdk-lead-capture-now-supports-rich-authorization-requests (28 Oct 2026, flag New, surface Tools, read 2026-10-31, HTTP 200) states Shop SDK lead capture accepts an authorizationDetails attribute (serialized JSON array, type urn:shopify:shop_app:data-sharing:v1) listing requested fields as required or optional; given name, family name, phone number and birthdate can be requested, and Shop prompts users for missing values before authorization. RAR is opt-in; existing integrations need no changes. Existing scopes shop_app:user:profile and shop_app:user:phone do not prompt for missing values.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: only relevant if video_shopify uses Shop SDK lead capture; could request phone/birthdate as optional fields later. No code or operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Confirm whether video_shopify uses Shop SDK lead capture; record yes/no before 2026-11-07.
